title: USF vs. FAU: Week 12 Betting Odds, Prediction
text:
USF vs. FAU: Week 12 Betting Odds, Prediction Football Basketball ACC Big 12 Big Ten Pac-12 SEC Newsletter Shop COLLEGE FOOTBALL USF vs. FAU: Week 12 Betting Odds, Prediction
 Andrew Pistone College Sports Wire Nov. 21, 2026, 5:50 a.m. ET USF head coach Brian Hartline is looking to wrap up his first season with the Bulls on a high note, but his program has dropped their last two games with two more left on the schedule. The Bulls lost a shootout last week against Memphis 52-41, as Hartline hopes his generally reliable defense can tighten up against FAU.
 The Owls have been pretty inconsistent this season, as they've alternated wins and losses in their last six games. They come into this contest having fallen to Tulsa 38-21, as FAU head coach Zach Kittley also hopes his defense can improve this week.
 If you are looking for some betting advice for the matchup, we've got you covered. Here are the latest odds for the game, courtesy of BetMGM.
 USF vs. FAU game odds:
 All college football odds via BetMGM
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. Spread: USF Even (-110), FAU Even (-110)
 Money Line: USF -110, FAU -110
 Over-Under: Over 64.5 (-110), Under 64.5 (-110)
 USF vs. FAU prediction, pick:
 As the odds indicate, this matchup is as even as even gets. There's a clear opportunity for USF to exploit FAU on the ground though, as the Owls have allowed the most rushing yards in the conference. Bulls running back D.J. Crowther somewhat surprisingly missed USF's last game, but has a chance to run wild if he's available and fully healthy.
 FAU's offense is led by quarterback Caden Veltkamp, who has had a tremendous season. Veltkamp leads the conference in passing yards, touchdown passes and total completions, and has linked up with Easton Messer early and often. Messer is the conference's leading receiver in catches, yards and touchdowns.
 Given that this game is a pick 'em, there are no point spreads to worry about, and bettors can just select who they think will win. FAU would appear to be better positioned to do so given Veltkamp's prolific campaign that should continue through the rest of the season.
 Prediction: FAU 35, USF 21
 Best Bet: FAU -110
